name: Sausage, Egg and Beans
method: Heat the grill to high. Grill the sausages for 15 to 20 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through with no pink inside.
Warm the beans in a small pan over a low heat for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring now and then.
Fry the eggs in the oil for 2 to 3 minutes until the whites are set, and toast the bread.
Serve the sausages, eggs and beans together with the toast.
